question: ISRO recently conducted a key development test under the Integrated Main Parachute Airdrop Test (IMAT) series in November 2025 for which mission?
solution:
**Answer:** C. **__Gaganyaan__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ISRO successfully conducted a crucial development test on the main parachutes for the Gaganyaan Crew Module at Babina Field Firing Range, Jhansi, as part of the Integrated Main Parachute Airdrop Test (IMAT) series on November 3, 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The test validated the parachute system’s performance under extreme conditions, including delay in disreefing between two main parachutes.
 
• The parachute system includes **10 parachutes of four types**—apex cover, drogue, pilot, and main parachutes.
 
• Reefed inflation technique ensures controlled deployment using **pyro devices** for reefing and disreefing stages.
 
• The Crew Module was simulated using a mass equivalent, dropped from an altitude of 2.5 km by an **Indian Air Force IL-76 aircraft**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The test confirmed safe descent and soft landing, validating the parachute’s structural integrity and load distribution.
 
• Developed by **Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC)** with support from **ADRDE (DRDO)**, the Indian Air Force, and the Indian Army.
 
• The IMAT series aims to qualify the parachute system for India’s first **human spaceflight mission – Gaganyaan**.
